newsitem.title: USA: NYC Water Authority raises ylds 20 BPs for retail.
newsitem.headline: NYC Water Authority raises ylds 20 BPs for retail.

text.p: The New York City Water Finance Authority, which saw Friday's big drop in Treasuries slice retail demand, on Monday said it raised yields by 20 basis points during the second day of a presale period.
This put the top yield for the retail scale at 5.40 percent in 2018.
Retail investors only placed $4 million of orders on Friday, and the presale period ends at 1500 EDT on Monday. Institutional investors will be offered the bonds on Tuesday.
"If the (the market) levels off, we basically adjusted the right amount," said a New York City official, who declined to be named. The agency is selling a total of about $365 million of bonds.

Separately, the state Environmental Facilities Corp raised yields by 15 basis points, financial market sources said, but this could not be immediately confirmed. The state agency is in the midst of selling almost $115 million of bonds on behalf of New York City's agency.
